headline_marked: Actress [[Sohana Saba remarries]] businessman Faisal Samad
headline: Actress Sohana Saba remarries businessman Faisal Samad
summary: The actress revealed that the wedding took place over 1.5 years ago in a private family ceremony following a 5.5-year relationship.
details: Actress Sohana Saba has announced her marriage to businessman Faisal Samad. The wedding took place over a year and a half ago in a private family ceremony, though the actress chose not to disclose the exact date.
Faisal Samad is the Managing Director of Savartex Group and Surma Garments Ltd, and a Director of the BGMEA. He previously served as a vice president of the BGMEA board of directors.
This is a second marriage for both Sohana Saba and Faisal Samad. Saba had a nearly 10-year marriage to filmmaker Murad Parvez, with whom she has a child.
Saba shared that she and Faisal had a romantic relationship for five and a half years before deciding to marry. She mentioned that she felt an immediate connection with him upon their first meeting.
The actress stated that her son is very happy with the new marriage and that the couple is currently living a happy life together.
caption:
After a 5.5-year relationship, actress Sohana Saba has revealed her marriage to businessman Faisal Samad.

This is a second marriage for both Sohana Saba and Faisal Samad. Saba had a nearly 10-year marriage to filmmaker Murad Parvez, with whom she has a child.

Saba shared that she and Faisal had a romantic relationship for five and a half years before deciding to marry. She mentioned that she felt an immediate connection with him upon their first meeting.

The actress stated that her son is very happy with the new marriage and that the couple is currently living a happy life together.

headline_marked: Govt to [[ensure Shakib Al Hasan's security]] if he returns to face cases
headline: Govt to ensure Shakib Al Hasan's security if he returns to face cases
summary: Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman says the cricketer will receive full security, despite calling him a 'rotten person' personally.
details: Prime Minister's Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman stated that there are no concerns regarding the security of cricketer Shakib Al Hasan if he returns to Bangladesh to face legal cases.
The statement comes after Shakib told Reuters that he would return to face the charges against him provided he is guaranteed security.
Dr. Zahed dismissed fears of attacks or mob violence at the airport or elsewhere, asserting that Shakib's return and legal process would be place under full security.
However, the Advisor sharply criticized Shakib's personal character, describing him as a 'rotten' and 'decayed' person due to his associations with former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
Dr. Zahed viewed Shakib's recent interview and statements as 'propaganda' and an attempt to create pressure on the government.

The Advisor also mentioned that while former PM Sheikh Hasina has expressed a desire to return in December, she too would receive full security and her constitutional rights during the judicial process.
He emphasized that while no 'fascist mafia regime' will be allowed to return, the most heinous criminals will not be deprived of their civic and constitutional rights as a democratic state.
caption:
Full security for Shakib Al Hasan if he returns to face cases, but the Information Advisor calls him a 'rotten person'.

Prime Minister's Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman stated that there are no concerns regarding the security of cricketer Shakib Al Hasan if he returns to Bangladesh to face legal cases.

The statement comes after Shakib told Reuters that he would return to face the charges against him provided he is guaranteed security.

Dr. Zahed dismissed fears of attacks or mob violence at the airport or elsewhere, asserting that Shakib's return and legal process would be place under full security.

However, the Advisor sharply criticized Shakib's personal character, describing him as a 'rotten' and 'decayed' person due to his associations with former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

Dr. Zahed viewed Shakib's recent interview and statements as 'propaganda' and an attempt to create pressure on the government.

The Advisor also mentioned that while former PM Sheikh Hasina has expressed a desire to return in December, she too would receive full security and her constitutional rights during the judicial process.

He emphasized that while no 'fascist mafia regime' will be allowed to return, the most heinous criminals will not be deprived of their civic and constitutional rights as a democratic state.
